title: Mulug (ST)** Venkatapur, Eturnagaram, Mangapet, Tadvai, Kothaguda,
text:
109. Mulug (ST) Venkatapur, Eturnagaram, Mangapet, Tadvai, Kothaguda,

Govindaraopet and Mulug Mandals.

10—DISTRICT: KHAMMAM

1[110. Pinapaka (ST) Pinapaka, Manuguru, Gundala, Aswapuram Mandals and

Bhurgumpadu Mandal excluding the Revenue Villages of

Seetharamanagram, Sridhara Velair, Gumpanapalli, Ganapavaram,
Ibrahimpet and Ravigudem (big).]
